title: Accounts Memorandum — The Late Fee Rate Carried at a Settlement of a Building Automation Service Plan
content:
# Accounts Memorandum — The Late Fee Rate Carried at a Settlement of a Building Automation Service Plan

**The rate.** Where the due day of the plan's most recent plan fee charge lies three whole months or more before the handling day, counted from that due day to the handling day, and the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans is billed quarterly or monthly, the charges required now carry the tier's late fee rate for each whole month the arrears have run. Where that due day lies one or two whole months before the handling day and the plan is billed quarterly or monthly, the charges required now carry the tier's late fee rate for one month. In every other case no late fee rate at all is carried. The rate so worked out is taken to six decimal places.

| Whole months from the due day of the most recent plan fee charge to the handling day | Tier's billing frequency | Rate the charges required now carry |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | quarterly or monthly | the tier's late fee rate for each whole month the arrears have run |
| 1 or 2 | quarterly or monthly | the tier's late fee rate for 1 month |
| fewer than 1 | quarterly or monthly | none |
| any | annual or semiannual | none |

## Points of judgement

- The months are whole months counted from the due day of the plan's most recent plan fee charge to the handling day; a part month at the end does not count.
- A plan billed annually or semiannually carries no late fee rate at a settlement, however long the arrears have run.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A plan billed quarterly whose most recent plan fee charge fell due 5 whole months before the handling day, at a tier whose late fee rate is 1.5 percent a month, carries 1.5 percent for each of the 5 whole months, that is a rate of 7.5 percent on the charges required now. On charges required now of 4000.00 USD the late fee is 300.00 USD. Had that due day lain 2 whole months back, the rate would be 1.5 percent for one month, that is 60.00 USD.
